dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: Oh, don't mind me. I'm just playing some intense music in my head — the kind that's perfect for forging.

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: I'm guessing you can't hear it? It's a pity that I'm tone-deaf as well, or I'd try singing it for you.

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: But feel free to stand by and listen to the rhythm of my ironworking. Just think of it as a form of street music.
